title: The Website Opportunities screens use one status pill, lock approved Business facts and read the brief as a five step checklist
steps: S1: From the checkout (no stand, no database) run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/site/tracy-website-opportunities/test/client-status-pill.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-website-opportunities/test/client-facts-locked.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-website-opportunities/test/client-brief-steps.test.mjs
S2: Read the summary lines pass and fail.
expect: The run exits 0 and its summary reads fail 0.
client-status-pill.test.mjs: every state renders through the one status pill.
client-facts-locked.test.mjs: approved Business facts offer no edit and show the Add this business again notice.
client-brief-steps.test.mjs: the brief page lists its steps with their states.
fence: The pure client models behind the pill, the approval lock and the brief checklist
